request: Track staff leave requests: employee name, leave type (vacation, sick, unpaid), start date, end date and number of days. Requests go from Requested to Approved or Rejected.

outcome.renderedDiff:
New record type "Leave request" with 6 fields:
  - State (one of "Requested", "Approved", "Rejected", required)
  - Employee name (text, required)
  - Leave type (one of "Vacation", "Sick", "Unpaid", required)
  - Start date (date, required)
  - End date (date, required)
  - Number of days (whole number, required)
  Each record belongs to one company.
  It gets its own menu entry "Leave request" with a list, a record page and a form.
  People who can use the rest of the application can create, change, archive and restore Leave request records.
New lifecycle for Leave request. Records start at "Requested".
  - Approve changes "Requested" to "Approved" after confirmation.
  - Reject changes "Requested" to "Rejected" after confirmation.

Stored data: a new table, a new index. Nothing already stored is changed or removed.
Rolling back hides this change again and keeps every record entered under it.
